item.title: Welcome
item.description:
This site is set up with Hugo and the Paper theme.

Things to change first:

  • Update baseURL, title, and profile details in hugo.toml.
  • Replace this post with your own writing.
  • Run the local dev server and tune the theme options you want to keep.
